statement: Vector quantization of the KV cache achieves high compression ratios (~82-83%) with fidelity closer to the full cache than scalar quantization or low-rank methods at comparable ratios, at the cost of lightweight offline codebook training. VQKV's RSimVQ (multiple residual codebooks + projection matrices, on-demand reconstruction) beats ASVD, Palu, KIVI, and SnapKV on LongBench at matched ratios on LLaMA3.1-8B/3.2-3B, because quantizing whole vectors preserves inter-dimensional structure that scalar quantization destroys. This positions VQ as a middle ground: higher fidelity than scalar quant, no LLM fine-tuning, but not training-free (codebooks trained on 0.1% of OpenWebText).
